description: Create a new node pool in an NKS cluster. Use dryRun=true to preview. Node spec: XEN (G2) clusters take productCode, KVM (G3) clusters take serverSpecCode + storageSize — both come from ncloud_nks_get_server_specs. On a Regional cluster (Public zone), zoneCode is required and must match the zone of the subnets the pool uses (400 on mismatch since 2026-09-17).

nodeCount.description: Number of nodes (required if autoscale not set)

productCode.description: XEN/G2 only: server product code (value from ncloud_nks_get_server_specs, e.g., SVR.VSVR.STAND.C002.M004.NET.SSD.B050.G002). Not listed on the node-pool guide page but used by the create-cluster nodePool item

serverSpecCode.description: KVM/G3 only: server spec code (e.g., c2-g3, from ncloud_nks_get_server_specs). For XEN pools use productCode instead

softwareCode.description: Server image code — value from ncloud_nks_get_server_images exactly as returned (XEN values have no '|' part, KVM values do)

storageSize.description: KVM/G3 only: storage size in GB (100-2000)

subnetNoList.description: Subnet numbers for the pool (must be among the cluster's subnets). Not listed on the node-pool guide page; without it the cluster subnets are used. Can be changed later with ncloud_nks_update_node_pool_subnet

zoneCode.description: Public zone only (Regional clusters): zone code (see ncloud_get_zones). Required for Regional clusters and, since 2026-09-17, must match the zone of the subnets assigned to this node pool — a mismatch is rejected with 400

name: ncloud_nks_create_node_pool
